result.summary: Found 1 visual issue: a persistent loading spinner remains visible over an already rendered restaurant card image.

issues.description: A circular loading spinner overlay is stuck in the center of the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' image under 'Popular right now', even though the card's image and details have already finished loading.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the loading indicator state is properly cleared and hidden once the image or card data finishes loading.
